description: agent-action under v62 whose scope_exercised repeats the grant but whose signed content is 999999 bytes. max_bytes is read from content.length, not from the claim: verifier MUST reject with E_SCOPE_DENIED.

expected.rejection_reason: The exercised scope is a sub-scope of the grant, but the content it signs is 999999 bytes and the grant allows 10. A content-bound key is checked against the signed content, so the claim does not decide.
